items.title: Podcast: Servier describes its M&A and manufacturing strategy amidst deal-making drive
items.summary: Servier’s head of business development Frederic Scaerou discusses the French company’s recent string of dealmaking.

items.title: Merck KGaA-backed Cyllene Therapeutics secures €33m for gene therapy pipeline
items.summary: Fresh with a rebrand, Cyllene will advance gene therapies built on a platform that uses a modified form of the herpes virus for delivery.

items.title: De-risking drug formulation with AI predictive modelling
items.summary: Through predictive modelling, AI supports target identification, prediction of physicochemical properties and formulation strategy selection.

items.title: Vertex signs agreement to acquire Crinetics for $10bn
items.summary: Vertex is to acquire Crinetics Pharmaceuticals in a transaction valued at nearly $10bn, or $8.8bn net of estimated cash acquired.

items.title: EC approves AbbVie’s Tepkinly combination for follicular lymphoma
items.summary: The EC has granted marketing authorisation for AbbVie’s Tepkinly in combination with lenalidomide and rituximab for adults with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma.
